title: Arm delivers record-breaking quarter and full-year results
summary: Arm delivered record-breaking Q4 FYE26 results, with revenue reaching $1.49 billion and full-year revenue at $4.92 billion.
body_markdown:
Scaling physical AI takes more than powerful hardware.


Hear from our Dermot O’Driscoll on @RoadtoAutonomy as he discusses how the Arm compute platform and ecosystem collaboration are helping accelerate the adoption of robotics and autonomous vehicles. 👇


[Twitter feed video.](https://newsroom.arm.com/wp-content/plugins/custom-twitter-feeds-pro/img/video-lightbox.png)

@RoadToAutonomy


The Physical AI market is growing, and @Arm's low power architecture is powering it.


Dermot O'Driscoll, Vice President, Go-To-Market for Physical AI at Arm, explains how a common architecture enables companies to scale Physical AI on The Road to Autonomy with @gbrulte.
